title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by the other schemas. Money is always integer minor units plus the currency's exponent from policy.currency_exponents; FX rates are decimal strings.

id.description: Opaque record or business id. The format carries no information about errors.

minor_amount.description: Non-negative integer amount in minor units of its currency.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset; offsets differ between documents.

rate.description: Decimal string: 1 unit of source currency = rate units of target currency.

range.description: Inclusive [low, high] integer range, or a single integer.
